notes.title: The Map
notes.content:
We're excited to finally say [b]Ehko Island[/b] is in review and will launch soon. It's our first Visual Novel, so it took everything we had to get to this point, and we learned so much along the way. We hope we got some things right and that you enjoy the ride.

Here's a look at how you will navigate around the island. As you move through the story, you will unlock locations on the map and be able to revisit them by clicking on the orange dots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283052/61a3f80f8aa009a9d9aac3ff74e6823a7279b2c3.jpg[/img]
